hero.title: Minseok Song
hero.subtitle: Founder @ Minseok Song & Company | Research Intern @ KAIST NNFC

blocks.title: Operating Thesis
blocks.body: My strength is Proactive Execution—transforming complex technical challenges into valuable Deep Tech strategies. I want to be someone who values hands-on experience over just words.

blocks.title: Lead
blocks.body: I am currently a Research Intern at KAIST NNFC and Founder of Minseok Song & Company, with a strong foundation in Physics and Semiconductor-Energy Convergence Science from Chungnam National University.

blocks.title: Body 1
blocks.body: My recent work involves designing interdigitated electrochemical devices and developing autonomous robot control systems. I've also successfully self-filed two patents combining deep tech engineering with legal strategy.

blocks.title: Body 2
blocks.body: From utilizing ultrasound velocity for non-invasive glucose monitoring to engineering smart noise enforcement signs using open innovation, I continuously aim to resolve critical technical gaps through structured data and applied logic.

events.title: Research Intern @ KAIST NNFC
events.body: Assisting next-generation micro-battery fabrication through planar interdigitated cell architecture and thin-film process execution.

events.title: Founder @ Minseok Song & Company
events.body: Building AI strategy systems and deep-tech business assets while self-filing two independent patents.

events.title: Collaborator @ KRISS
events.body: Worked as an independent student researcher and first author on ultrasonic glucose research after classes during the semester, with the supervising PhD researcher's verbal approval.

events.title: Research Intern @ KRISS
events.body: Completed ultrasonic velocity measurement and high-damping specimen identification work during a KRISS research internship.

events.title: URA @ Semiconductor Sensor Lab
events.body: Optical Analysis Research on Air-Suction High-Sensitivity Nitro Group Sensor.
